append.detail: CLOSED 2026-10-05: giftGems in lib/rewards/gifts.ts calls isBlockedBetween right after the recipient-exists check and returns the same not-found message when either side has blocked the other, so every gift caller inherits the block and the sender cannot tell they were blocked.
